## 🌐 Démonstration WebR Live {background-color="#f0f8ff"}

### Code R exécutable dans le navigateur

```{webr-r}
# Création de données de démonstration
demo_data <- data.frame(
  Pays = c("France", "États-Unis", "Chine", "Allemagne", "Japon"),
  Production_2020 = c(338.7, 809.4, 344.7, 60.9, 43.1),
  Part_Monde = c(14.2, 33.9, 14.5, 2.6, 1.8)
)

cat("📊 PRODUCTION NUCLÉAIRE 2020\n")
cat("===========================\n\n")

library(knitr)
kable(demo_data,
      col.names = c("Pays", "Production (TWh)", "Part (%)"),
      digits = 1)
```

---

## 📈 Visualisation Interactive

```{webr-r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

viz_data <- demo_data %>%
  mutate(Pays = factor(Pays, levels = Pays[order(Production_2020)]))

ggplot(viz_data, aes(x = Pays, y = Production_2020, fill = Pays)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Production_2020), " TWh")), 
            hjust = -0.1, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Production Nucléaire 2020",
    x = "", y = "Production (TWh)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)))
```

## 🎨 Mix Énergétique Mondial

```{webr-r}
energy_mix <- data.frame(
  Source = c("Nucléaire", "Hydro", "Solaire", "Éolien", "Gaz", "Charbon"),
  Part = c(10.1, 16.2, 3.2, 6.6, 23.4, 40.5)
)

energy_colors <- c(
  "Nucléaire" = "#2E86AB", "Hydro" = "#118AB2",
  "Solaire" = "#FFD166", "Éolien" = "#06D6A0",
  "Gaz" = "#EF476F", "Charbon" = "#073B4C"
)

ggplot(energy_mix, aes(x = "", y = Part, fill = Source)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = energy_colors) +
  labs(title = "Mix Énergétique Mondial 2020") +
  theme_void(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```
